title: A Semester for the Detention
author: Zephyrine Amberdale
blurb: Kestrel Joubert, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
